svg.text: Hexagonal architecture (ports and adapters) of the Scala / Play backend, as built
Dependencies point inward: adapters → ports → application → domain. Yellow tabs are ports. AppComponents (AppLoader.scala) is the only place that connects an adapter to a port.
services with in-memory ports, domain functions directly
Enforced, not just drawn: ArchitectureSpec fails if a domain, application or port file imports an adapter, the HTTP layer, play.api.mvc, Anorm, JDBC or SQL helpers.
Database outcomes are translated at the edge: EXCLUDE violations → SlotTakenError / VehicleBusyError (PgSchedulingStore), deadlocks → TransientStorageError (Db.tx). No SQL code reaches a use case.
Cross-module needs are narrow ports owned by the consumer: booking sees ConsultationBookingPort (3 methods) and OwnedVehicles (1), the guard sees Authenticator (1).
Kept on purpose (docs/solid-review.md): metrics and the request logger are cross-cutting; play-json input Reads sit with the use cases; ports take a DbSession so a use case
can make several writes atomic; password hashing is a plain module; seed, migrations and /health run SQL directly because they are infrastructure tools.
